informational.text: ds-modal and ds-modal-card measure their [actions] row again when a button's label or the set of actions changes after the modal opens, so a label that grows past the card stacks the row instead of clipping the first button at the card's start edge.
informational.verify: Open a sm modal with two short buttons, then change one label to a long one while it stays open: the row stacks into a full-width column with both buttons inside the card.
